description: Source code for ECUEditorMenuBar class, which defines a GUI menu bar for an ECU editor application, including menu items for settings, image comparison, conversion, viewing properties, user levels, and help/about information.

classes.name: ECUEditorMenuBar
classes.description: A custom menu bar for the ECU editor application, providing menu items for editing, viewing, converting images, and help/about information.

methods.name: updateMenu
methods.description: Updates the menu items based on the current state, such as enabling/disabling options depending on the selected ROM file.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles actions triggered by menu item selections, such as opening dialogs, changing user levels, or showing about information.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves the currently selected ROM image to a file.

methods.name: getImageOutputFile
methods.description: Displays a file save dialog and returns the selected file for saving the image.

methods.name: writeImage
methods.description: Writes byte array data to the specified file and updates the ROM's filename.

methods.name: getRepositoryOutputDir
methods.description: Displays a directory chooser dialog for selecting a repository directory.

methods.name: saveAsRepository
methods.description: Saves ROM tables into text files within a selected repository directory.

methods.name: increaseRomSize
methods.description: Converts the ROM image to a larger size (from 160KB to 192KB).

methods.name: decreaseRomSize
methods.description: Converts the ROM image to a smaller size (from 192KB to 160KB).

methods.name: getLastSelectedRomFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the last selected ROM, or an empty string if none is selected.
